facts.applies_to: As listed by U.S. DOL, page updated November 5, 2026
facts.summary: Oklahoma basic state minimum wage listed by U.S. DOL: $7.25.
facts.evidence_quote: Employers with ten or more full time employees at any one location or employers with annual gross sales over $100,000 irrespective of number of full time employees. Basic Minimum Rate (per hour): $7.25 All other employers Basic Minimum Rate (per hour): $2.00 The Oklahoma state minimum wage law does not contain current dollar minimums. Instead the state adopts the federal minimum wage rate by reference. The State law excludes from coverage any employment that is subject to the federal Fair Labor Standards Act.
facts.source_title: State Minimum Wage Laws (U.S. DOL Wage and Hour Division)
facts.source_publisher: U.S. Department of Labor, Wage and Hour Division
facts.notes: Multiple rates listed by DOL (see quote): $7.25, $2.00 | Local (city or county) minimum wages are not included. Scheduled January 1, 2027 increases are not reflected until DOL updates the page.

facts.summary: Oklahoma is not listed with a final 2026 FUTA credit reduction, so the effective FUTA rate is 0.6% on the first $7,000 per employee (if the full 5.4% state credit applies).
